description: This file defines the OrderGroup class, which manages a collection of Order objects associated with a patient and encounter within the OpenMRS platform. It includes methods to manipulate order lists, handle nested groups, and maintain group metadata.

classes.name: OrderGroup
classes.description: Represents a group of related orders for a patient encounter in OpenMRS, supporting nesting, ordering, and metadata.

methods.name: getOrderGroupId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the order group.

methods.name: setOrderGroupId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the order group.

methods.name: getPatient
methods.description: Retrieves the patient associated with this order group.

methods.name: setPatient
methods.description: Associates a patient with this order group.

methods.name: getEncounter
methods.description: Gets the encounter linked to this order group.

methods.name: setEncounter
methods.description: Sets the encounter for this order group.

methods.name: getOrders
methods.description: Returns the list of orders within this group, initializing if null.

methods.name: setOrders
methods.description: Assigns a list of orders to this group.

methods.name: addOrder
methods.description: Adds a single order to the group without specifying position.

methods.name: addOrders
methods.description: Adds multiple orders to the group.

methods.name: addOrder
methods.description: Adds an order to the group at a specified position, auto-calculating sortWeight.

methods.name: findListIndexForGivenPosition
methods.description: Determines the correct index in the list for inserting at a given position, handling negative indices.

methods.name: findSortWeight
methods.description: Calculates the sort weight for a new order based on its position in the list.

methods.name: getOrderSet
methods.description: Retrieves the associated order set.

methods.name: setOrderSet
methods.description: Sets the order set for this group.

methods.name: getParentOrderGroup
methods.description: Returns the parent order group if nested.

methods.name: setParentOrderGroup
methods.description: Defines the parent order group; supports nesting.

methods.name: getOrderGroupReason
methods.description: Gets the concept representing the reason for this order group.

methods.name: setOrderGroupReason
methods.description: Sets the reason concept for this order group.

methods.name: getPreviousOrderGroup
methods.description: Returns the previous order group for linkage.

methods.name: setPreviousOrderGroup
methods.description: Defines the previous order group for linkage.

methods.name: getNestedOrderGroups
methods.description: Returns nested order groups.

methods.name: setNestedOrderGroups
methods.description: Sets nested order groups for complex nesting.
